free.name: Free
free.description: Everything a community server needs to run support.

features.text: HTML transcripts (text always saved, no message cap)
Webhook whitelabel (your server name & avatar on ticket messages)
features.note: Reposts ticket messages under your server's name and avatar via Discord webhooks. Slash commands and DMs still show the host bot. Full identity replacement (own bot) is an Enterprise feature.

Configurable retention window (e.g. 30 / 90 / 180 / 365 days), capped at 365 days for Free and can't be disabled. Closed tickets and their transcripts are auto-deleted when they reach your chosen limit. Premium removes the cap.

features.text: Bring your own storage for attachments
features.note: Optional. Connect your own external storage in the dashboard to keep ticket attachments long-term. Without it, attachments fall back to Discord's CDN URLs (best-effort, can expire). Transcript text is always preserved on us. Available on every tier, including Free.

premium.name: Premium
premium.description: For servers that need scale, retention, and integrations.

features.note: We host the attachment storage for you - no external storage to configure. Free is BYO-only; Premium adds 5 GB of managed storage so attachments just work out of the box.

features.text: Extended ticket retention (no 365-day cap, or disable entirely)
features.note: Free is capped at 365 days and can't be disabled. Premium removes both limits - pick any window (2 / 3 / 5 years, etc.) or turn retention off entirely to keep tickets forever. Useful for compliance, audits, and long-running support cases.
Coming soon. Semantically search every closed ticket - 'find tickets about refunds' returns matches even when the word 'refund' was never used.

enterprise.name: Enterprise
enterprise.description: For large communities and resellers running RooTicket under their own brand.

features.text: Own Discord bot (full whitelabel - your name on commands, DMs, member list)
features.note: We spin up a dedicated worker that runs your Discord application's bot. Paste your token and we sync your slash commands to it. The host RooTicket bot leaves your server on activation.

features.text: SLA on backfill (sub-30s recovery, dedicated shard)
features.note: Coming soon. Backfill itself works on Free as best-effort today.
Coming soon. Bound by Discord's 45-day audit-log window once shipped.

features.text: Priority support - direct line to the operator

items.a: You can use RooTicket for support, applications, reports, and other requests where a structured ticket flow helps your team.

items.q: Is RooTicket ready to use now?
items.a: Yes. RooTicket is live at rooticket.app and already in use. You can invite the bot and get started right away.
Click “Add to Discord”, invite RooTicket to your server, then open the dashboard to set up your first panel and subject.

items.q: Will I have to pay later?
items.a: RooTicket is focused on staying free for most communities. If paid options are introduced in the future, they would be for features with real operating costs (such as AI or storage). Nothing paid is being sold today.

items.q: Need help or want to share feedback?
items.a: Join our Discord support server to get help, report issues, or share ideas with the team.
